scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n BACKEND,FRONTEND -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w @comment-video-studio/backend" "npm run dev -w @comment-video-studio/frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @comment-video-studio/shared && npm run build -w @comment-video-studio/backend && npm run build -w @comment-video-studio/frontend && npm run bundle:server
scripts.test: npm run test -w @comment-video-studio/shared && npm run test -w @comment-video-studio/backend && npm run test -w @comment-video-studio/frontend
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @comment-video-studio/shared && npm run typecheck -w @comment-video-studio/backend && npm run typecheck -w @comment-video-studio/frontend
